evidence_status_definition: PARTIALLY_SUFFICIENT means some relevant properties are documented, not that the full frozen question is affirmatively satisfied.

documents.authority: Official Legacy Surveys DR5 files documentation
documents.applicability_to_DR5: Explicit DR5 page; product descriptions apply to DR5. Not an inspection of newly acquired FITS or a guarantee of every pixel state.
relevant_sections: Summary Files: survey-bricks-dr5, ccds-annotated-dr5, depth summaries
Sweep Catalogs: ANYMASK/ALLMASK, FRACMASKED, PSFSIZE, FLUX_IVAR
Image Stacks: ccds, image, invvar, depth, galdepth, nexp
claims_supported: DOCUMENTED: coadd image is inverse-variance weighted, nanomaggies per pixel, resampled with Lanczos-3; stacked invvar is based on sum of input inverse variances.
DOCUMENTED: nexp counts contributing exposures; depth and galdepth describe source-flux detection sensitivity, not pixel-quality classes.
DOCUMENTED: ANYMASK/ALLMASK refer to the central pixel across exposures; FRACMASKED is profile-weighted; PSFSIZE is a weighted FWHM summary.
DOCUMENTED: CCD metadata and calibration-version columns are described.
claims_not_supported: UNRESOLVED: spatial classification across a crop of unsupported, invalid, masked, saturated, interpolated, cosmic-ray, bleed, artifact and valid-zero states.
UNRESOLVED: documented full per-pixel DR5 coadd quality-mask product or independently sufficient alternative for A10. Absence from this document does not establish physical absence.
UNRESOLVED: positive ivar, nexp or finite values as sufficient evidence of clean pixels; source FLUX_IVAR as pixel inverse variance.
documents.sufficiency_basis: Useful affirmative statements are present, but the entire frozen question is not satisfied.

documents.applicability_to_DR5: Explicit DR5 processing description; describes upstream coadds, not a certified deployed normal-cutout service operator.
claims_supported: DOCUMENTED: convenience stacks use Lanczos-3 on TAN grids at 0.262 arcsec/pixel.
DOCUMENTED: explicit limitation against precision work; no project-specific adequacy threshold is supplied.
DOCUMENTED: Tractor fits individual exposures, avoiding interpolation and covariance complications; individual-CCD PSFs are spatial PSFEx models.
DOCUMENTED: upstream sky processing includes spatial spline sky estimation from masked medians over sliding 512-pixel boxes.
claims_not_supported: UNRESOLVED: sufficient effective spatial coadd PSF, or demonstrated sufficient proxy, for MIPS A11/B4.
UNRESOLVED: quantitative coadd covariance/noise prescription and bounds on morphology effects satisfying B2.
UNRESOLVED: either universal morphological uselessness or project adequacy inferred from the precision warning.
UNRESOLVED: deployed normal-cutout commit or its second resampling operator.
contradictions: DOCUMENTED: download guidance loosely describes native-scale cutout pixels as approximately those used by Tractor, while the processing sections distinguish stacks from individual exposures. INFERRED: this is not an identity guarantee and does not override the explicit product distinction.
documents.sufficiency_basis: Useful affirmative statements are present, but the entire frozen question is not satisfied.

documents.authority: Official Legacy Surveys acknowledgment and image-usage statement
documents.applicability_to_DR5: General current statement, explicitly names DECaLS among produced image layers; not a DR5-specific FITS/auxiliary redistribution grant.
relevant_sections: Usage of images from the Sky Viewer
claims_supported: DOCUMENTED: produced Legacy Surveys/DECaLS image layers are covered by the stated CC BY 4.0 image terms and visible-credit conditions.
DOCUMENTED: scientific publications using the data have prescribed acknowledgments.
DOCUMENTED: Sky Viewer hosts multiple surveys with their own terms; permissions cannot be generalized to all layers.
claims_not_supported: UNRESOLVED: explicit scope for scientific FITS/coadd-derived cutout and associated-metadata redistribution.
UNRESOLVED: separate comprehensive permission for local preservation and the proposed scientific FITS operation; intended scientific use does not itself define that complete license scope.
UNRESOLVED: equivalence of rendered-image terms and scientific-dataset terms.
documents.sufficiency_basis: Useful affirmative statements are present, but the entire frozen question is not satisfied.
